changes: Highground: `/hg users` shows detected users by realm, party, raid, instance and guild, plus versions. Its global total counts each character once across contexts.
Highground discovery uses small, staggered announcements and expiring records. Optional newer-version notices appear at most once per session and once per day.
Shared-profile reviews in Highground keep completed, cancelled and replacement transfers from showing stale progress or timeout notices.
Highground and standalone Macros keep queued spell-rank upgrades together and explain whether combat or an occupied cursor is delaying them.
Highground and standalone Arena keep duel requests, countdowns and active fights consistent, including repeated notifications and changes of bounds.
notice: Restart WoW after updating Highground to load the new discovery files; /reload is not enough. Install every folder in its ZIP. Standalone-only Macros/Arena updates from the previous version need /reload. CurseForge files may await moderation.
